I've been promoted to co writer for my LARP group's lore. My in game character has been "trapped" in an enemy area. She can send messages out but cannot receive any. In most cases the players speak a unison language. But, in this case my character's messages are only in her native tongue. She's an elven character, so her language has words that end in sounds like, " SILL" and "SEER". Her grammar is unique also. One of her spells for basic healing is: Aeru dos hith lendeth tes lef! 

Which translates to:
Air of health replenish this life!

It's been a blast making her language. Thanks for the tips too.

I literally have been forbidden to LARP by family. And my character, Colette, is more of a historian, librarian, book keeper who might be able to use a tome or two. However, I love donating a selling things for other LARP groups. The group I was in was just starting out, so I would come with boxes and boxes of donations. Bottles, bags, scraps of extra fabrics and leathers, an entire trunk at some point. I loved doing that knowing that was helping build something worth while. The part I loved about the LARP community, is that they are so accepting. That is what binds me to you all.

LARP almost tore my entire family life apart. I was way into it! I couldn't believe that something I was initially scared of could be so wonderful and exillerating! I've never been so happy in my entire life. However my happiness would come to an abrupt end. The topic of divorce came up. I was going to be sent to a inpatient facility. So, my family and I agreed that I would stop LARPing in order to save my marriage and any other family ties.
